newsitem.title: USA: Harmon unit gets contracts in Scotland.
newsitem.headline: Harmon unit gets contracts in Scotland.

text.p: Vaughan Harmon Systems Ltd, a subsidiary of Harmon Industries Inc, said Monday it was awarded two contracts by Railtrack Scotland valued at about $5 million.

Vaughan Harmon will supply Train Describers at Motherwell and Glasgow Central and at Edinburgh in Scotland. Train Describers follow the location of trains from dispatching centers and transmit that information to managing centers using microprocessor-based technology.

"Vaughan Harmon and its position in the U.K. market continue to play a significant role in Harmon Industries' initiative to expand our international market share," said Bjorn Olsson, Harmon's president and chief executive officer, in a news release.
Harmon supplies signal and train control products to freight and transit systems.
